origin.description: Lorenz curve of the Pareto distribution, with one shape parameter.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Population shares in the unit interval.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Pareto shape. The default is 2, and only the first element is used.

origin.details: When the shape is greater than 1, the curve is 1 - (1 - p) raised to (shape - 1) / shape. Otherwise the call warns and uses the default shape 2, which gives the exponent 1/2. The function has class theorLc.

translation.description: Lorenz curve of the Pareto distribution, with one shape parameter.

arguments.name: p
arguments.text: Population shares in the unit interval, as a scalar or an array.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Pareto shape. The default is 2. A sequence contributes its first element.

translation.details: A shape above 1 sets the exponent to (shape - 1) / shape, and the ordinate is 1 - (1 - p) to that power. Any other shape warns and uses the exponent 1/2 that belongs to the default shape 2. The result keeps the shape of p.
translation.value: Lorenz ordinates at p, as a NumPy array of the same shape.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from ineq.theor import lc_pareto

p = np.arange(1, 11) / 10
print(lc_pareto(p))
